name: CI: Lint PHP (PHPCS + optional PHPStan)
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-lint-php.yml. Runs PHPCS (and optionally PHPStan) over changed files in a PR, or the whole project on push. EXPERIMENTAL: the upstream workflow is currently in rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows PR #2 and has not yet shipped on `v1`. Pin `wsw_ref` to the PR branch or a SHA until the PR merges.

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call. Workflow is in PR #2 at the time of writing; pin to `v1.0.0/task/ci-lint-workflows` or a commit SHA until the PR is merged into v1.
Run PHPStan after PHPCS. Pass 'true' or 'false'.
